item.title: Using a tidy approach in R to analyze Mexico’s 2024 ENVIPE
item.dc:creator: Juan Armando Torres Munguía
item.description: In this article, I will guide you through the process of analyzing Mexico’s 2024 National Survey of Victimization and Perception of Public Safety (Encuesta Nacional de Victimización y Percepción sobre Seguridad Pública, ENVIPE) using the {tidyverse} framework for survey analysis with the {srvyr} package. Specifically, we will calculate the crime prevalence rate per 100,000 inhabitants by state, according to the victim’s sex ( Tasa de prevalencia delictiva por entidad federativa por cada cien mil habitantes, según sexo de la víctima).
